headline: Captain Polyplast reports 5% profit growth in Q2
hook: Profit growth follows diversification into solar
summary: Captain Polyplast posted a 5% increase in net profit for the second quarter. The company attributed the growth to rising demand and its recent diversification into solar EPC and polymer markets. For the first half of the fiscal year, net profit rose 7% to ₹9 crore. This performance reflects the firm's transition beyond its traditional business segments.
why_it_matters: Diversification into solar EPC is driving the company's bottom line growth.
